will integrate technologies from Gilbarco Veeder-Root and Invenco to create a scalable and efficient fuelling solution across the retailer’s petrol stations.

Building on the integration between Invenco’s outdoor payment applications and Gilbarco Veeder-Root’s fuelling and forecourt management systems, Tesco will gain deeper operational insights and a smoother customer experience.

Gilbarco Veeder-Root’s DOMS PSS 5000 Forecourt Controller and Invenco’s connected outdoor payment terminals will enable fast and compliant transactions at the pump or at the kiosk, the companies said.

title: Vontier secures deal to upgrade tech across 700+ Tesco petrol stations
